cases.name: city_walk
cases.prompt: A pedestrian in a yellow coat walks along a wet city sidewalk at dusk. The camera tracks smoothly beside them, with reflections and moving traffic in the background.

cases.name: forest_run
cases.prompt: A runner wearing a blue jacket jogs along a winding forest trail. Sunlight passes through leaves as the camera follows from behind.

cases.name: reef_fish
cases.prompt: A school of colorful fish swims around a coral reef in clear blue water. The underwater camera moves slowly forward through the scene.

cases.name: robot_work
cases.prompt: A small industrial robot arm sorts colored wooden blocks on a workbench. A steady camera shows repeated precise movements and changing block positions.

cases.name: flower_wind
cases.prompt: Red and white flowers sway in a garden breeze, with bees moving between blossoms. A close camera slowly pans across the flower bed.

cases.name: fabric_dance
cases.prompt: A dancer in a long flowing green dress turns in a sunlit studio. The camera tracks the movement while fabric folds change continuously.

cases.name: waterfall
cases.prompt: Water cascades over dark rocks in a mountain stream. The camera slowly moves upstream, revealing foam, ripples, and mist.

cases.name: toy_train
cases.prompt: A red toy train circles a wooden track through a miniature town. The camera stays low beside the tracks as the train passes buildings and trees.

cases.name: kitchen_cook
cases.prompt: A cook chops vegetables on a kitchen counter and places them in a steaming pan. A steady medium shot shows the hands, utensils, and rising steam.

cases.name: snow_ski
cases.prompt: A skier in an orange jacket carves turns down a snowy slope. The camera follows smoothly, with snow spraying and distant mountains visible.

cases.name: tennis_match
cases.prompt: Two tennis players exchange shots on an outdoor court. A stable wide shot shows the players moving, the ball crossing the net, and shifting shadows.

cases.name: bird_flight
cases.prompt: A white seabird flies along a rocky coastline over turquoise waves. The camera tracks the bird from the side as its wings flap and the landscape moves behind it.

cases.name: fireworks_night
cases.prompt: Bright fireworks expand above a city river at night. Reflections ripple on the water while boats drift slowly below the illuminated skyline.

cases.name: portrait_turn
cases.prompt: A woman with curly hair turns her head and smiles while standing near a sunny window. A close steady camera captures natural facial movement and shifting hair.
